```sql
WITH contra_costa AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Contra Costa County' AND border_type ILIKE 'county'
),
parks_in_contra_costa AS (
  SELECT p.geometry
  FROM parks p
  JOIN contra_costa c ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, c.geometry)
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, true, (SELECT geometry FROM parks_in_contra_costa), true) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry FROM parks_in_contra_costa))
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
slope_values AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpAsPolygons(rast)).* 
  FROM slope_raster
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ST_Area((SELECT geometry FROM parks_in_contra_costa)::geography) / 1000000, 2) AS total_land_area_sq_km,
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS average_steepness_degrees
FROM slope_values;
```
